title: 敌对行为无后果
description: 敌对行为没有实际后果，击杀飞行员并出售部件后无任何反应，游戏世界缺乏反馈。
evidence: I boarded a neutral ship above K-Log, and the game indicated that this was a hostile act with consequences. However, neither the pilot nor anyone on K-Log recognised this.
